notes: Open subset: Weighted O/D points for the Tahoe routing benchmark sampler. Weights are comparable only within a category; mix categories with 'purposes'. Residential and job points are LODES block points snapped to ~110 m and summed. No private or usage data is included.
attribution: Contains data from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright) and US Census LEHD LODES 8, 2023 (public domain).

attraction.description: OSM attractions, museums, viewpoints, casinos, ski areas (season-tagged).

bike-shop.description: OSM bicycle shops and rentals (LTBC's Mapbox bike-shop dataset is another source).

civic.description: OSM library, post office, town hall, community centre, hospital, clinic.

food.description: OSM restaurants, cafes, fast food, bars, ice cream.

home.description: LODES RAC 2023 resident workers (all jobs), block internal points snapped to ~110 m and summed. Origin for commute/errands/school.

lodging.description: OSM hotels/motels/hostels/campgrounds/vacation apartments; weight = rooms/capacity tag or a type default. Visitor origin.

park.description: OSM parks/sports centres/marinas/golf; weight by area.

school.description: OSM schools/colleges; weight by level heuristic (no enrollment data).

work.description: LODES WAC 2023 jobs, block internal points snapped to ~110 m and summed. Excludes self-employed.
